_meta.title: Fourth immutable checkpoint of five substantively researched Group A candidates
_meta.evidence_policy: Read source descriptions, exact source coordinates, date-stamped reports, official operator and geographical evidence when accessible, distinguishing current questions, historic claims, and physical sites. No present sexual activity inferred.

original_preexisting_record.name: Shnelli Park
original_preexisting_record.place_summary: Shnelli Park is parkland by historic Toompark and Schnelli pond beside Tallinn old town, near Balti Jaam. Gays-Cruising page presents claimed high influx, but its sole visible dated visitor comment from April 2025 disputes the claim and says no activity/poor privacy. No 2026 substantiation.

original_preexisting_record.name: Nude Beach
original_preexisting_record.place_summary: Nude Beach source entry is not Tallinn's ordinary Stroomi Beach; its details explicitly identify an unofficial naturist stretch beyond Pikakari beach on the Paljassaare peninsula. A July 2025 news article independently reports nude sunbathers (pre-cutoff) but NOT gay sexual activity; August 2025 directory commenter mentions old military bunker as cruising spot (pre-cutoff). Protected Paljassaare reserve requires compliance with marked nature paths. No 2025-11 onward corroborated sexual activity.

Comment 2025-08-11 alleges 'old bunker behind nude beach' as cruising spot, outside recent twelve-month cutoff; 2024 travel plan earlier. Source ratings low influx, medium privacy, all day undated.

original_preexisting_record.name: Promenade WC
original_preexisting_record.place_summary: Promenade WC is public toilets described by Gays-Cruising as near Tallinn port Terminal D; source says 06:00–01:00 and no visible visitor comments. Port authority confirms nearby Terminal D and distinct cruise-terminal promenade access, but does not confirm toilets at the exact source point or permit sexual activity. Operator D Terminal hours also differ on Saturday, so the directory hours must not be given as official toilet hours.

previous_saved_batch_record.name: Circus
previous_saved_batch_record.place_summary: Tbilisi Circus historic gay cruising spot specifically refers to stairs and wooded paths leading to Circus on hill by Heroes Square, not the auditorium. Directory lists crowd metrics and four platform check-ins within the crawl's prior month, which do not independently document a physical visit. Its July 24 2025 user says they attended on two days and had fun, but pre-2025-11-06 cutoff. May 24 2026 comment asks who is present. A February 2024 comment complains of additional lighting and cameras; current surveillance unverified. Circus operator confirms site and public-facing parking and official visitor hours, not external path rules.

verification_sources.notes: 2025-07-24 positive firsthand, 2026-05-24 inquiry; 4 platform checkins last month at crawl, no verification
Tbilisi Circus near Heroes Square; operator hours are NOT outdoor paths hours

prior_source_research.name: Karvasla Bathrooms
prior_source_research.place_summary: Karvasla Bathrooms is the restroom area of Karvasla commercial shopping centre at Tsotne Dadiani 7, Tbilisi, distinct from Kidobani. Directory page describes it as cruising location but also says it can be hard to meet anyone; claims high influx despite no visible comments and zero current checkins. Business registry updated Jan 21 2026 confirms trading centre operating, not activity. Public restrooms, legal/privacy considerations.
